title: Craig Campbell's Digital Marketing Podcast
author: Craig Campbell
description: Craig Campbell's Digital Marketing Podcast gives you insight and knowledge into various aspects of the Digital Marketing Industry. Each episode features an interview with a Digital Marketing expert with questions designed to give you as many tips and tricks as possible. Whether you're interested in affiliate marketing or social media marketing, the variety of experts who have been interviewed means that there will definitely be some gems hidden within episodes for even the most experienced digital marketers.
